The `editbox.c` and `editbox.h` text-input control comes from the SDL_ttf
`release-3.2.2` examples. The original permissive license and attribution are
retained at the beginning of both files.

Source: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_ttf/tree/release-3.2.2/examples

Local changes are marked in `editbox.c`. This control handles text layout,
selection and IME preedit; the application document model owns persistent
content and undo history.
